title: A Sigil for the Ember
author: Coral Sterling
blurb: Elodie Eastwick, an exiled storm-caller, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
